Why interruption, asynchronous tools, and state correctness matter as much as speech quality.","excerptZh":"结合9月15日公告与Audio模型卡，分析实时对话、后台工具执行和复杂推理如何协同，以及语音Agent应该如何评测。","tags":["Gemini 3.8 Live","Voice Agents","Multimodal","Real-Time AI"],"readTime":"6 min","sections":[{"heading":{"en":"The news: dialogue while work continues","zh":"新闻焦点：一边对话，一边执行任务"},"paragraphs":[{"en":"Google announced Gemini 3.8 Live and Live Extended Thinking on September 15. The launch distinguishes a model aimed at scalable live dialogue from a variant aimed at more complex reasoning. The accompanying Audio model card describes audio, image, video, and text inputs for the Live models, with text and audio outputs.","zh":"Google于9月15日发布Gemini 3.8 Live和Live Extended Thinking。公告区分了面向规模化实时对话的模型，以及面向更复杂推理的版本。配套Audio模型卡描述了Live模型的音频、图像、视频和文本输入，以及文本和音频输出。"},{"en":"This retrospective focuses on the launch's dialogue and background-work design, not later benchmark updates. A voice assistant must acknowledge the user quickly while external work may take seconds or minutes. Smooth speech and successful task execution are different outcomes, and both need to be measured.","zh":"这篇回顾聚焦发布时的对话与后台执行设计，不引用后续更新的榜单数字。语音助手需要快速回应用户，而外部任务可能持续数秒甚至数分钟。说话流畅与任务完成是两种不同结果，需要分别测量。"}],"sources":[1,2]},{"heading":{"en":"Two clocks: conversation and execution","zh":"架构分析：对话时钟与执行时钟"},"paragraphs":[{"en":"I find it useful to model two clocks. The conversational clock tracks turn-taking, speech onset, pauses, and interruptions. The execution clock tracks tool requests, pending results, retries, and committed state. A quick acknowledgment belongs to the first clock; a confirmed booking belongs to the second. Confusing them creates false success messages.","zh":"一个有用的设计方法是把系统看成两条时间线。对话时钟管理轮次、开口延迟、停顿和打断；执行时钟管理工具请求、等待结果、重试和已经提交的状态。快速说一句“正在查询”属于前者，确认预订成功属于后者。混淆两者，就容易把进度口播误当成任务成功。"},{"en":"For example, a user may change a requested time while a search is running. The system needs a request identifier and a version of the user's intent. When the old result returns, it should be reconciled with the current intent before being spoken or acted on. Faster generation alone does not solve this race.","zh":"例如，查询还在运行时，用户修改了希望预约的时间。系统需要为请求分配标识，并保存用户意图的版本。旧结果返回时，应先与当前意图核对，再决定是否播报或执行。单纯提高生成速度，解决不了这种竞态问题。"}]},{"heading":{"en":"Interruption must have explicit semantics","zh":"交互设计：被打断之后，后台工作怎么办"},"paragraphs":[{"en":"Stopping speech, cancelling a model turn, and cancelling an external action are separate operations. In a prototype, I would represent an action as proposed, pending, committed, failed, or cancelled. An interrupted response should never silently imply that a committed action was undone. Conversely, a cancelled task should not continue making changes merely because a tool call is already in flight.","zh":"停止播音、终止模型的一轮生成，以及取消外部操作，是三个不同动作。在原型中，可以把操作状态明确分为待确认、执行中、已提交、失败和已取消。回复被打断，不应让用户误以为已经提交的操作也被撤回；反过来，用户取消任务后，也不应仅因工具调用已经发出就继续悄悄修改状态。"},{"en":"This suggests using idempotency keys for repeatable requests, explicit reconciliation after timeouts, and a visible action history when the product supports consequential changes. These are system-design recommendations, not claims that the model provides transaction guarantees by itself.","zh":"因此，对于可能重试的请求，应考虑幂等键；超时后需要状态核对；当产品涉及实际状态变化时，应提供可查看的操作记录。这些是系统设计建议，不能当成模型本身已经提供事务保证。"}]},{"heading":{"en":"Build a voice-specific evaluation","zh":"评测方法：不要只测转写或回答正确率"},"paragraphs":[{"en":"A useful test suite would include interruptions, background noise, corrections halfway through a tool call, slow dependencies, and a failed action after a confident acknowledgment. Measure response latency distributions, interruption recovery, factual consistency with tool state, and accepted end-to-end tasks. Human listeners should separately judge whether progress narration is helpful or distracting.","zh":"一套有用的测试应包含打断、背景噪声、工具调用中途改口、依赖服务缓慢，以及口头确认之后实际操作失败。指标应覆盖响应延迟分布、打断恢复、播报与工具状态的一致性，以及端到端任务验收率。还应让听众单独评价进度口播究竟有帮助，还是制造干扰。"},{"en":"The model card is the right place to begin reading about evaluated capabilities and limitations; the application's own traces are where deployment quality must be established. For me, the key opportunity in live models is a better interaction loop, provided the system always knows the difference between saying it is working and proving the work is complete.","zh":"模型卡适合用来了解已评估的能力与局限，而应用自己的运行轨迹才是判断部署质量的依据。实时模型的重要机会在于改善交互循环，前提是系统始终分得清：说“正在处理”和证明“已经完成”之间的区别。"}],"sources":[2]}],"sources":[{"title":"Google — Gemini 3.8 Live launch","date":"2026-09-15; page subsequently updated 2026-09-17","url":"https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/models-and-research/gemini-models/gemini-3-8-live-gemini-3-8-live-extended-thinking/"},{"title":"Google DeepMind — Gemini 3.8 Audio model card","date":"2026-09-15","url":"https://deepmind.google/models/model-cards/gemini-3-8-audio/"}]}}],["$L7"],"$L8"]}],{},null,false,null]},null,false,"$@9"]},null,false,"$@9"]},null,false,null],"$La",false]],"m":"$undefined","G":["$b",["$Lc"]],"S":true,"h":null,"s":"$undefined","l":"$undefined","p":"$undefined","d":"$undefined","b":"Ijy8mNuywzMmfrpc5fVLn"}
